description: End-to-end skill evals — test whether Claude Code or Codex uses the shunt scripts correctly

evals.prompt: What are all the exported items in evals/fixtures/websocket-handler.ts and what do they do?
evals.expected_output: The host should invoke bulk-read with the matching --backend (Claude also has a large-read hook)
expectations: The host ran the bundled scripts/bulk-read with --question and --paths
The host did NOT read the full file directly
The host provided a summary based on the bulk-read output

evals.prompt: Write unit tests for UserService following the pattern in order-service.test.ts.
evals.expected_output: The host should invoke code-write script with --spec, --reference, and --target
expectations: The host ran the bundled scripts/code-write with --spec and --reference
Output was written to a target file via --target
The host reviewed the generated output before accepting it

evals.prompt: There's a bug on line 42 of websocket-handler.ts where the heartbeat interval isn't cleared on disconnect. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: The host should NOT delegate — debugging requires reasoning, not bulk I/O
expectations: The host did NOT run bulk-read or code-write
The host read the file with offset/limit for the relevant section
The host applied reasoning to the debugging task
